item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Oasis + Cage The Elephant + Cast @ Rose Bowl 2025-09-06 (Raw Wavs)
item.description:
In the end I am down $27.16 for both shows but I don't really feel going back tonight. Took all of my energy just getting out of there. Got home at 2:30am and feel lucky it was that early. I am 10 miles away.

Cast went on 5 mins ahead of schedule - after the start time got moved up an hour so it's a little messy in the beginning. At least it was pretty loud, even in the very back.

All at

+ + + + +

Was glad they pulled out Acquiesce and stuck it in early. I remember early 1996 and the first tapes from the Morning Glory started to roll in. And I had the 2 albums to start matching songs to titles. But I had no title for the opening song and it was the best song of the set! Twas a few months til I figured it out. The B sides collection The Masterplan was just as good as the first 2 albums but after that it was hit and miss, mostly miss. LA never got a proper Morning Glory tour show. Saw the next tour twice but there was a serious loss of traction not to mention touring a weak album.

YES, you had to wait for tapes to come in the mail to even know what a band was playing and it could take a few months. But it was also one of the great joys in life getting a package in the mail, unfortunately even each small package coming in is getting hit with a $80 fee so now gotta be real selective when looting overseas collections
